com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Clear the selected whole-invoice or printed-line load allocation. Removing a whole-invoice tag retains the individual line allocations. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview clearing this invoice's whole-document load tag while retaining its printed-line allocations. Wait for my confirmation.
Preview clearing only the allocation for the printed-line index we selected. Show the affected allocation and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_clear_invoice_load, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare clearing the exact whole-invoice or printed-line allocation. Clearing a whole-invoice tag retains all line allocations. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
